messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The webhook dispatcher's deploy window is on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- The billing service ships only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-05]
- As of the 2025-06-05 rotation day, Marcus is the primary on-call for Team Boreal, and Lena is off rotation. [valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05]
    earlier: As of the 2025-04-16 rotation day, Lena carries the Team Boreal on-call phone, having received the pager from Marcus. [valid 2025-04-16 to 2025-06-05; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-16]
    earlier: Marcus carries the Team Boreal on-call phone from the 2025-02-27 rotation swap until the next rotation. [valid 2025-02-27 to 2025-04-16; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- On 2025-03-17, Tomasz Nowak wrote the handover document for the billing service handover for Marcus. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, and flagged it since the feature-flags service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- Farah is the release captain for Team Dune for Q3 2025. [valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22-2]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [decision; valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2]
- As of 2026-03-10, Farah is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now. [valid 2025-01-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-10]
- Priya is not the Atlas pager contact for the cycle starting 2025-02-19. [constraint; valid 2025-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-19]
- On 2025-12-23, Team Atlas noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-23]
- As of 2026-06-08, Farah is the primary on-call for Team Dune. [valid 2026-06-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Tomasz Nowak is the primary on-call for Team Dune. [valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-06-08; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-13]
- Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- As of 2026-02-04, Tomasz Nowak is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle, instead of Farah. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-15, Farah is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle, instead of Tomasz Nowak. [valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-02-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-27, Tomasz Nowak is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle, instead of Farah. [valid 2025-10-27 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-22, Farah is the primary on-call for Team Dune. [valid 2025-09-22 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-22]
- As of 2026-02-23, the scheduler's deploy window remains weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-02-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-23]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
